desc: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、干燥毛皮 x2、铜锭 x1、木炭 x1、易碎瘴气花瓣 x1、任意纤维 x1

desc: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、干燥毛皮 x2、铜锭 x3、木炭 x3、巨型生物鳞片 x5

desc: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x2、铜锭 x1、木炭 x1、亚麻布 x3、雾霭囊 x1

desc: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.
ingredients_zh: 铜锭 x1、木炭 x1、腐化野猪獠牙 x2

desc: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、干燥毛皮 x1、铜锭 x2、木炭 x2、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc:
A warrior's boots that used to brandish a golden sheen. They've dulled due to the fungal overgrowth.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x4、巨兽肋骨 x2、皮革 x2、青铜锭 x2

desc: A metal cuirass with subtle embossing on it. The pattern is reminiscent of golden tangled vines, now sprouting with delicate mycelium. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x6、巨兽肋骨 x4、亚麻布 x5、青铜锭 x5

desc: Reinforced gloves with makeshift chitin plating.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x5、巨兽肋骨 x3、皮革 x4

desc:
A helmet made from petrified insectoid critter legs assembled to grasp at the wearer's face like claws.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x4、巨兽肋骨 x1、青铜锭 x3

desc:
A pair of rotting pants, held together by stabilizing chitin shells.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x6、巨兽肋骨 x2、亚麻布 x3、青铜锭 x5

desc: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x4、保暖衬垫 x4、钢锭 x6、甲壳粉 x25

desc: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x10、保暖衬垫 x8、钢锭 x12、黑曜石 x5、紫水晶 x10、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x4、保暖衬垫 x4、木炭 x4、黑曜石 x2、紫水晶 x2、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x2、煤炭 x4、保暖衬垫 x3、钢锭 x5、紫水晶 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: These leg guards protect the wearer's sides from incoming strikes.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x6、保暖衬垫 x6、钢锭 x8

desc: These boots are enhanced with metal plates, providing more defense to the sensitive shins of the skeletons wearing them.
A combination of rust-red fabric, metal plates, and gold accents. The latter usually matches the Hollow's gold teeth!
Heavy gloves, usually carried by bony or rotting ice-cold fingers.
An extravagant helmet with red plumes, traditionally worn by high-ranking army commanders.
Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of died blood on them.
These boots seemingly once belonged to a ruler who's name has been lost to time. It faded into oblivion, leaving only a title and lingering curse.
A fearsome chest piece. It's rumored to have belonged to a fallen warrior whose name is never spoken out loud.
Legends say that these gloves once belonged to a dark ruler whose name has been wiped from the history books.
It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.
This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.
You've likely never work foot armor this light, but give it a shot - the chest plate's weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.
ingredients_zh: 水爬虫皮革 x6、水豚鬃毛 x2、金粉 x10、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing - piercing it would be no easy task.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、绿矾粉尘 x6、金锭 x2、迸裂荒野之心 x1、红色布料 x2

desc: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.
ingredients_zh: 绿矾粉尘 x5、水豚鬃毛 x2、金粉 x1、红色布料 x1、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1

desc: Just one look into these eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x1、绿矾粉尘 x5、金锭 x2、鱼类象牙粉尘 x2

desc: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.
ingredients_zh: 棕榈叶 x4、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、水豚鬃毛 x4、鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.
obtain: is looted from a chest in the Goldrock Saddle Inn, you'll find the lore note on the first floor and the chest containing the gauntlets at the top floor. thumb|The Goldrock Saddle Inn, located in the northeast part of town.

desc: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Cold Heights under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord Vorgoth finally reached the gates of Pikemead's Reach, weapon raised high.
Untouched by the Flame, and veiled in a lingering cold. This armor used to belong to Lord Vorgroth, who was rumored to have a frozen heart that splinters and breaks with every tired beat.

Wearing these gloves, the Northern Lord carved his way through the enshrouded valleys of Embervale. The scars he cut into people and soil can be traced from Cold Heights's bleak mountains to today's ruins of Pikemead's Reach.

Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping Vorgoth from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.
Pants that were formerly worn by soldiers of Lord Vorgoth, oldest son to Queen Pikemead. Legends say he was consumed by the Shroud after the Ancients pushed him off Howling Pike's summit.
Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x2、琥珀 x4、青铜锭 x3、木炭 x2、腐蚀之血 x5

desc: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、皮革 x4、青铜锭 x6、琥珀 x3、木炭 x3、小动物腺体 x6

desc: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、皮革 x2、青铜锭 x3、琥珀 x2、木炭 x2、迷雾粘合剂 x3

desc: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.
ingredients_zh: 琥珀 x3、青铜锭 x3、木炭 x2、石化瘴气潜行者壳 x5

desc: Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x4、皮革 x3、木炭 x2、青铜锭 x4、酸性菌丝 x15

desc: A knight's boots. They've seen much peril and anguish.
A knight's chestplate. It has a fading heroic aura.
Royal gloves, befitting a true knight of honor.
The helmet of a long - forgotten knight. With a bit of polish, it will be as good as new.
Knightly pants. The cloth attached brandishes a glorious golden thread.
Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down !
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x2、木炭 x2、青铜锭 x3、腐蚀之血 x5

desc: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、皮革 x3、木炭 x3、青铜锭 x4、琥珀 x6、小动物腺体 x6

desc: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、皮革 x1、木炭 x2、青铜锭 x2、氨腺 x1

desc: This sturdy Mercenary Helmet protects your eyes and hides your expression, making you appear fearless and intimidating.
ingredients_zh: 木炭 x2、青铜锭 x2、石化瘴气潜行者壳 x5

desc: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x4、皮革 x2、木炭 x2、青铜锭 x3、薄荷蘑菇肉 x15

desc: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x3、保暖衬垫 x5、钢锭 x3、甲壳粉 x25

desc: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always crast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x10、煤炭 x6、保暖衬垫 x8、钢锭 x6、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercly.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x4、煤炭 x3、保暖衬垫 x4、钢锭 x3、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x2、保暖衬垫 x4、钢锭 x2、黑曜石 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、保暖衬垫 x7、钢锭 x4、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Expertly crafted boots. They've been embellished with flame-spouting shields, a roaring inferno only kept at bay through vigilance.
Showcase your beaming soul of flames and cast out all evil once and for all! The light thunders and roars with every heartbeat.
These gloves radiate warmth and safety as if they were forged in pure liquid light.
A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.
This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.
Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.
ingredients_zh: 动物毛皮 x2、树脂 x5、金属板 x1、菌丝体（材料） x15

desc: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits - the perfect chest armor for begginer.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x4、动物毛皮 x4、树脂 x2、金属板 x3、活性菌丝 x25

desc: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x4、动物毛皮 x2、金属板 x2、充气女妖凝胶 x1

desc: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.
ingredients_zh: 金属板 x1、动物毛皮 x1、树脂 x3、充气女妖凝胶 x1

desc: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.
ingredients_zh: 金属板 x2、细线 x4、动物毛皮 x3、雾瘴液体 x5

desc: Adventures who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.
ingredients_zh: 皮革 x4、衬垫 x2、鳞片 x10、堕落镰刃之雾 x1

desc: A well - balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨粉末 x10、衬垫 x6、鳞片 x30、堕落之心 x3

desc: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend !
ingredients_zh: 化石骨粉末 x2、衬垫 x3、鳞片 x10、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x5

desc: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts and scars.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨粉末 x5、衬垫 x1、鳞片 x15、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: The metal plates provide added protection against jagged or poisoned arrows.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x5、鳞片 x20、易碎瘴气薄片 x25

desc: A pair of boots which is covered in silvery scales. Your ankles will be safe and sound with these.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、木炭 x5、铁锭 x2、堕落镰刃之雾 x1

desc: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x3、衬垫 x5、木炭 x8、铁锭 x5、堕落之心 x1

desc: Few enemies can withstand even an unarmed blow dealt with these gloves.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、衬垫 x2、木炭 x4、铁锭 x2、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x5

desc: A finely crafted helmet, usually worn by the kingdom's most feared warriors and generals.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x1、木炭 x4、铁锭 x1、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: Thick and reliable pants. Not very breathable, unfortunately.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、木炭 x7、铁锭 x4、雾霭沙 x25

desc: The gleaming gold and vibrant green crystals adorning the chestplate make it a shield and a statement of enduring strength. Watch out for the spiked shoulder pads!
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、绿矾粉尘 x10、水爬虫皮革 x2、金锭 x2、迸裂荒野之心 x1

desc: These gloves offer you sufficient protection when you engage in melee combat.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x2、金粉 x5、绿矾粉尘 x2、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1、鱼类象牙粉尘 x4

desc: Embody golden grandeur with this ornate helm - and a gaze as unyielding as stone itself.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x1、棕榈叶 x5、绿矾粉尘 x5、甲壳粉 x1

desc: These pants are just as short as a foe's lifespan in your presence.
ingredients_zh: 钢锭 x6、布料 x4、水豚鬃毛 x4、棕榈叶 x4、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: Thanks to their wrapping technique, these shoes provide good support while allowing you to remain agile.
ingredients_zh: 钢锭 x6、金粉 x10、水豚鬃毛 x2、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、木炭 x2、干燥毛皮 x2、铜锭 x2、易碎瘴气花瓣 x1

desc: The improved copper coating of this Tank Chestplate can withstand many more blows at the frontlines of battle.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x5、木炭 x3、干燥毛皮 x2、铜锭 x5、琥珀 x3、巨型生物鳞片 x5

desc: Copper - plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.
ingredients_zh: 树脂 x1、干燥毛皮 x1、亚麻布 x2、铜锭 x2、木炭 x2、雾霭囊 x1

desc: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.
ingredients_zh: 铜锭 x2、木炭 x2、腐化野猪獠牙 x2

desc: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x3、干燥毛皮 x1、铜锭 x3、木炭 x4、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc: No one can tread past you when you're wearing these steadfast boots.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、铁锭 x4、木炭 x8、皮革 x2、堕落镰刃之雾 x1

desc: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x8、铁锭 x8、木炭 x12、青金石 x5、堕落之心 x1

desc: Heavy gloves that can swing any weapon with added might.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x4、铁锭 x4、木炭 x8、青金石 x4、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x5

desc: Command respect with this Warden Helmet.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、衬垫 x2、铁锭 x3、木炭 x5、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x6、铁锭 x6、木炭 x9、雾霭沙 x25

desc: The metal parts on these reinforced gloves are bent from one too many reckless swings
These boots were designed to allow for reckless charges and dashes. The metal tips at the front prevent you from stubbing your toes.
Risky but agile upper body armor. At least your shoulders will be safe from harm with these impressive spaulders!
Dive headfirst into battle with this Warrior Helmet!
The pieces that cover the sides of these pants have been carefully forged to defend against flanking attacks.
These spiked boots can cause a lot of damage when used to pierce arteries in one, swift swinging kick.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x6、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.
ingredients_zh: 银锭 x2、保暖衬垫 x6、硬化皮革 x10、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Silver-framed metal gloves with elaborate finger plates. The fingertip covers sharpen at the end into claw-like points.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨粉末 x2、保暖衬垫 x3、鳞片 x10、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.
ingredients_zh: 银锭 x1、保暖衬垫 x1、硬化皮革 x3、雾锁独眼巨人之眼 x1

desc: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x5、硬化皮革 x6、雾锁之冰 x50
